title: Host build of loader-diag-xnu-sc3-md1 for NAT-113: the loader's PX/PR pixel report at the kernel's return (panel memory statistics + 108x234 thumbnail, screen-recording statistics), rec_secs=30 rec_mb=64, loader_return_after=63; host tests, mutation pass, session driver derivation, decision draft; no phone action

glue113.h compiled for the host against synthetic memory; tests cover counts, thumbnail, recording header/range refusals, pacing; mutation pass with no unexplained survivors
session_nat113.py derived from session_nat110.py by counted substitutions and checked; preflight without a decision file refuses before any device access
Decision draft states the watchdog bound, the measured return-channel rate, the pass rule and the restore protocol
steps: build.py, src/glue113.h, decode113.py, test_nat113.py, mutate_nat113.py, derive113.py in docs/procedures/nat-113 (NAT-113 stays the native run)
Run tests and a mutation pass; build and package; record hashes in evidence
notes: Corrects NAT-113's original acceptance: 120 s is not safe (this loader's S5E9945 watchdog is unfed after the jump; the 'WDT paused' claim came from the S9 loader in references/hakios-scion-full), and there is no bulk-IN path for a full recording (EP0 TEXT ~3.2 KB/s measured in NAT-111), so the loader sends statistics and a thumbnail instead.
